narrative.overview:
KheroWeb pairs a split dark screening-room hero with alternating hairline-divided editorial bands (#08090C / #0C0E13) so the promise, BaridiMob/RedotPay price anchor, primary خلّص ديريكت and secondary احكي معايا triggers, full 16:9 VSL with chapter shortcuts, and 4-pillar summary strip fit cleanly in the initial desktop viewport without boxy stacked card fatigue.

Across lower bands, layout rhythm alternates structure rather than repeating uniform cards: hairline editorial objection columns and a unified comparison split (#why), a vertical 6-module sidebar paired with a single-column hairline-divided inspector stage (#curriculum), a 2x2 tactile الپاك bento with one flat inset proof per card (#pack), a warm slate work-pipeline spotlight (#work), an unboxed step track above a flat zero-form payment/chat deck (#enroll), and a sticky sidebar hairline FAQ (#faq).
keyCharacteristics: Unboxed alternating obsidian canvas (#08090C primary ground, #0C0E13 alternating band with 1px hairlines rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.09)), elevated only cleanly on slate surfaces (#12151D / #181C27) and recessed specimen/copy wells (#0A0C10) with zero nested-card boxing.
Self-hosted Alexandria (400–900) Arabic RTL typography paired with tabular Chivo Mono (400–700) reserved strictly for timecodes, module indices, prices, and RIP/ID codes.

Cinema Vermilion (#FF5520) reserved strictly for live prices, active VSL scrub/chapters, active module/method tabs, keyboard focus rings, and خلّص ديريكت; Confirm Emerald (#22C55E) reserved strictly for copy-check feedback, comparison ticks, curriculum ticks, and الپاك availability tags.

Strict craft floor: >= 44px x 44px interactive geometry, >= 0.86rem minimum typography, neutral black elevation shadows (zero dark-glow), zero one-sided borders on rounded containers, and zero eyebrows/kickers.

rules.name: The Asymmetric First-Fold Rule
rules.body: Desktop hero splits copy/prices/CTAs alongside the 16:9 VSL so visitors immediately see both the offer and the video above the fold.

rules.name: The Flat Container Rule
rules.body: Never nest multiple bordered rounded boxes inside cards; use alternating full-bleed grounds, 1px hairline grids, and single-level recessed specimen wells.

rules.name: The Surgical Vermilion Rule
rules.body: Cinema Vermilion (#FF5520) highlights live prices, active states, focus rings, and primary enrollment actions only.

rules.name: The Legible Floor Rule
rules.body: Every element across desktop, mobile 390px, and specimen wells renders at >= 0.86rem (>= 13.76px).

dos: Do keep >= 44px x 44px touch geometry and logical RTL CSS properties (margin-inline, padding-inline, text-align: start) on every control.
Do use gap: 1px hairline grids so desktop columns cleanly turn into horizontal dividers when stacked on mobile.
Do preserve natural first-person Algerian Darija ("أنا خيرو", "نعلّمك", "احكي معايا", "لي كليون") and always spell الپاك with three-dot peh (پ).
donts: Don't nest bordered cards inside bordered cards or leave orphan grid cells on 3-bullet modules.
Don't drop text sizes below 0.85rem (13.6px) or add colored box-shadow halos behind dark containers.
Don't re-introduce Name/Phone <input> forms, profile picture.jpg, fake testimonials, external font CDNs, or Unicode icon characters.
